verdict.rationale: Fellow documents its own MCP Server for asking an AI assistant natural-language questions about meetings, such as "What did we decide in last month's standup?". Its pricing page also lists an "Ask Fellow" feature, but gives no description of it. The answering runs through external assistants (Claude, ChatGPT), and nothing shows that answers cite the source meetings or transcript passages. missing for 10: evidence that answers include sources/citations, documentation of the native Ask Fellow Q&A experience, explicit coverage of the entire meeting history, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can ask questions in natural language across my whole meeting history ("what did we decide about pricing?") and get answers with sources

citations.quote: Ask anything about your meetings - Get answers to questions like "What were my action items this week?" or "What did we decide in last month's standup?"
Fellow's Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server allows you to ask your AI Assistant about your meetings, without needing to write any code.
Your favorite AI chatbot like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now tap directly into your meeting recaps, notes, and action items
